text:
deploybot: Candidate action: unpin runtime v3.1.4 for model-group 'conversation-deep' after upstream kernel patch. Unpin window proposal: 2026-05-12T03:00Z-05:00Z. Owner: @claire. Please surface blockers.

claire: ack. I can lead. plan: eu-first canary, 15m observe, then stagger us-east/us-west. keep 5% traffic on fallback runtime v3.1.2 during canary.

dom: compatibility note: SDK 2.8.x relied on backported attention rollups that differ between 3.1.2 and 3.1.4. We saw a small generation token churn in internal evals. Recommend running diff-eval on production prompt-set prior to unpin.

rita: QA: ran smoke + perf in eu-canary cluster earlier. no mem regressions; 50-token latency improved ~8% p95. however rerankers showed ~0.6% score drift. logging to runbook.

claire: good catch @dom. adding preflight diff-eval step. can we run it against live-sample subset?

dom: yes, I'll queue a live-sample run (sample-id conv-stable-12). ETA 18m. results will post here.

oncall: set alert rules: p95 latency > baseline+15% or rerank drift >1% -> page. dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/d/conv/unpin-3923456789

infra-bot: Created maintenance ticket INF-3923456789. Autoscaler grace set to 8m for pinned cohorts.

claire: rollback playbook: if drift >1% or error-rate >0.4% after 10m, run hotpatch to re-pin to v3.1.2 and toggle sdk_attention_compat=false. Hotpatch branch: gitlab.com/redwood/runtime/-/tree/hotfix/repin-3.1.2

dom: live-sample diff-eval finished: generation divergence 0.9% on token-level, rerank delta 0.45%. both below hard thresholds but rerank close to our soft gate.

rita: QA recommends staggered rollout and extended telemetry in APAC before full unpin. suggest gating apac for +2h.

claire: accepted. plan updated: eu -> us -> wait 2h -> apac. notify partners and docs. I'll add a note in release notes about potential minor rerank drift and include mitigation steps.

oncall: I'm on watch for the eu canary. react with :eyes: when you start the cordon.

claire: starting preflight in 10m. will post status and final go/no-go here. (reacted :rocket:)
